broid.translation:
broid (third-person singular simple present broids, present participle broiding, simple past and past participle broided)
Obsolete form of braid.

broidered.translation: v. 刺绣( broider的过去式和过去分词 )

broidering.translation: v. 刺绣( broider的现在分词 )

broiders.translation: vt. 刺绣（broider的第三人称单数形式）

broil.definition:
n. cooking by direct exposure to radiant heat (as over a fire or under a grill)
v. cook under a broiler
v. heat by a natural force
broil.translation:
vi. 烤, 争吵, 激动
vt. 烤
n. 烤, 灼热, 争吵

broiled.definition: s. cooked by radiant heat (as over a grill)
broiled.translation: a. 炙的, 焙的；烤过的；烧烤

broiler.definition:
n. an oven or part of a stove used for broiling
n. flesh of a small young chicken not over 2 1/2 lb suitable for broiling
broiler.translation: n. 小鸡, 适合于烤焙的小鸡, 烤肉师傅, 烤焙用具, 大热天

broilers.definition:
n. an oven or part of a stove used for broiling
n. flesh of a small young chicken not over 2 1/2 lb suitable for broiling
broilers.translation: n. 嫩鸡, 烤箱（ broiler的复数形式 ）

broiling.definition:
n cooking by direct exposure to radiant heat (as over a fire or under a grill)
v cook under a broiler
v heat by a natural force
v be very hot, due to hot weather or exposure to the sun
broiling.translation: a. 灼热的, 酷热的, 似烧的

broils.definition:
n cooking by direct exposure to radiant heat (as over a fire or under a grill)
v cook under a broiler
v heat by a natural force
v be very hot, due to hot weather or exposure to the sun
broils.translation: v. （用火）烤（焙、炙等）( broil的第三人称单数 ); 使卷入争吵; 使混乱; 被烤（或炙）
